properties.displayName: UAV S39 - Living-off-the-Land Ground Infrastructure Compromise
properties.description: Volt Typhoon 스타일 LOTL(Living-off-the-Land) 지상 인프라 침해 탐지. UAVOpAudit_CL의 admin_cmd_exec 이벤트 중 관리도구(powershell/wmic/certutil/mshta/rundll32/psexec/bitsadmin/regsvr32 등)가 Approved_Operators_List에 없는 계정으로 실행되거나, 비정상 ParentProcess(services.exe/wmiprvse.exe/svchost.exe)에서 기동된 경우를 탐지. MITRE: T1059, T1570
properties.query:
let approvedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
let lotlTools = dynamic(["powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "wmic.exe", "certutil.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "psexec.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "regsvr32.exe"]);
let suspiciousParents = dynamic(["services.exe", "wmiprvse.exe", "svchost.exe"]);
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVOpAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == "admin_cmd_exec"
| where ProcessName has_any (lotlTools)
| extend isUnexpectedAccount = Operator !in (approvedOps)
| extend isSuspiciousParent = ParentProcess in (suspiciousParents)
| where isUnexpectedAccount or isSuspiciousParent
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnexpectedAccount and isSuspiciousParent, "LOTL_비인가계정_비정상Parent_동시",
    isUnexpectedAccount, strcat("LOTL_비인가계정_관리도구실행_", Operator),
    strcat("LOTL_비정상_ParentProcess_", ParentProcess))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, TargetHost, Operator, ClientIp, ProcessName, ParentProcess, CommandLine, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S39 - Living-off-the-Land Ground Infrastructure Compromise - {{TargetHost}}
